description: This Java class models a database relation within the OFBiz entity framework, representing the <relation> element with properties like relation type, related entity, foreign key, and key mappings. It includes methods for creating instances from XML elements or reference info, and for generating XML representations.

classes.name: ModelRelation
classes.description: Immutable class representing a database relation, including relation type, related entity, foreign key, key mappings, and XML serialization.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate ModelRelation with specified properties or from XML element or reference info.

methods.name: getCombinedName
methods.description: Returns a combined name (title + related entity name).

methods.name: getKeyMaps
methods.description: Returns the list of key mappings.

methods.name: isAutoRelation
methods.description: Indicates if the relation was auto-generated.

methods.name: findKeyMap
methods.description: Finds a key map by field name.

methods.name: findKeyMapByRelated
methods.description: Finds a key map by related field name.

methods.name: toXmlElement
methods.description: Serializes the relation to an XML element.

methods.name: keyMapString
methods.description: Returns a string of key field names separated by a delimiter.

methods.name: keyMapUpperString
methods.description: Returns a string of key field names with first character uppercased.

methods.name: keyMapRelatedUpperString
methods.description: Returns a string of related key field names with first character uppercased.
